# docker_stack (Data Source)

Reads the services of one Swarm stack, like `docker stack services`: mode, `running/desired` replicas, image and published ports per service. Tasks are not listed; use `data.docker_tasks` with the `com.docker.stack.namespace` label.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_stack" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
}

output "replicas" {
  value = { for s in data.docker_stack.shop.services : s.name => s.replicas }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The stack namespace.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of services_json, to detect drift without diffing the document.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon for this read/apply.
- `images` (Map of String) Map of short service name to its image (digest pin removed, as the CLI shows it).
- `service_ids` (Map of String) Map of short service name (without `<stack>_`) to service ID.
- `services` (Attributes List) One entry per service: the `stack services` row plus the full spec. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `services_json` (String, Sensitive) Inspect of the stack's services as one JSON array (GET /services filtered by namespace). Sensitive: service env.
